result.text:
SELECT ID, V, U, S, W, R
FROM T;

SELECT DISTINCT P.Name
FROM P INNER JOIN C ON P.PID = C.PID;

FROM P INNER JOIN C ON P.PID = C.PID;

UPDATE T SET V = V + 1
WHERE ID <= 2;
